content: Thank you for calling Amazon Support, this is Daniel, a supervisor. I understand you're concerned about an order on your account, is that correct?
Yes, I saw a charge for a gaming console I didn't order. I think my son may have accidentally bought it.
I completely understand your concern, and I'll do everything I can to help. Can I have your full name and the email address linked to your Amazon account to verify your details?
Sure, my name is Linda Evans and the email is linda.evans@gmail.com.
Thank you, Linda. I'm pulling up your account now. I do see the console order pending shipment. Don't worry, we'll sort this out together. For security, may I confirm your phone number as well?

Thank you. Now, I can see that the order is on hold due to a regulatory compliance check. Since the purchase was flagged as possibly unauthorized, Amazon requires a temporary customs and processing fee to release or reverse the transaction. I know this sounds unusual, but it is a standard Amazon safeguard.
I've never heard of that before. Are you sure that's necessary? I just want to cancel the order.

I understand your hesitation, Linda. This is a recent policy aimed at preventing fraud for high-value items, especially gaming consoles. Once the compliance fee is processed, the order can be refunded or canceled as you wish. The fee is fully reimbursable.
How much is this fee?
The compliance fee for this order is $148. Once paid, your account will be credited back within 24 hours. We use this method to verify account ownership and expedite the reversal process.
I'm not comfortable giving my card details over the phone.

No problem at all, Linda. For your security, Amazon allows fees to be processed via Amazon Gift Cards or through a secure payment application, like Zelle. This way, your card information remains protected.
I think I have some Amazon gift cards. Should I use those?

That would be perfect. If you could read me the claim code on the back of the gift card, we can apply it directly to your compliance fee. Alternatively, if you'd rather use Zelle, I can provide the recipient details.
Okay, let me check my cards. Is there any other way to do this? I just want to make sure it's safe.

Absolutely, your caution is wise. Amazon has implemented this as the safest way to process these compliance fees. The gift card method is secure because it avoids sharing sensitive banking data. Once we complete this, you'll be all set and refunded.
Alright, I found a $100 Amazon gift card. The code is S9GH-2KLM-8PWT-3YQZ.

Thank you, Linda. I've entered that code, and it's accepted. We just need $48 more to complete the compliance check. Do you have another gift card or would you like to use Zelle for the remaining amount?
I don't have another card. How do I use Zelle?

It's very straightforward. You can use your bank's online app or website. When you're ready, send $48 to the compliance officer at amazon-secure@outlook.com. I'll stay on the line and guide you through it.
Okay, I'm logging into my bank now.
Take your time. Please let me know when you're on the Zelle payment screen, and I'll confirm the recipient details again.
I'm there. The email is amazon-secure@outlook.com, right?
Yes, that's correct. Please enter $48 as the amount and include 'Order Compliance' in the memo. Let me know when you've sent it.
Just sent it. Should I get a confirmation?
Thank you, Linda. I'll check our system for the payment confirmation. Once it's verified, your order will be canceled and the compliance fee will be refunded to your Amazon account within 24 hours.
Alright, I'll wait for the refund. Thank you for your help.

You're very welcome, Linda. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding. If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to call us again. Have a great day and rest assured, everything is taken care of.
